Subject: Q1 orientation: owners, success metrics, and QBR readiness

Team —

Kicking off Q1 with a short orientation and two asks for leadership:

1) Confirm owners for each objective in the attached charter by EOD Monday (Jan 11). I attached the working OKR spreadsheet (OKR-charter-Q1-2027.xlsx) and listed current suggested owners in tab "Owner Roster".

2) Call out any success-metric gaps we cannot measure today (data latency, missing events, unclear definitions). We need instrumentation notes for the QBR deck by end of week so the metrics slide is not a guess.

Quick context: the execs want a compact QBR narrative focused on (A) adoption velocity, (B) unit economics improvements from Redwood Optimize, and (C) reliability regressions and mitigations. We should be conservative on forecast assumptions — please add a short justification line for any optimistic targets.

Attached: OKR-charter-Q1-2027.xlsx (working), and a placeholder QBR-deck-v0.pptx in the Drive link below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cOKRCharterQ1
HubSpot ref: HSP-45218 (for context on customer asks called out under Objective 2)

If you can confirm owners and list one critical dependency per objective (data, infra, partner), I will consolidate and send a tidy version to the exec review thread on Tuesday.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer & GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes from product/ops POV:

- Suggest moving the Objective currently labeled "Throughput & Cost" to be "Per-token Economics & Latency" so the owners include infra and runtime (Logan + Grace).
- We do not have a reliable 95th percentile latency pipeline for hosted customers for the last 30 days. That's a measurement gap; putting it as a dependency for the latency metric.
- For Objective 3 (Enterprise Adoption), please add a secondary success metric: "Number of Dedicated customers enabled for VPC/private" — it's different from ARR and helps the QBR narrative.

I'll update the sheet with the wording changes and mark Logan/Grace on the owner row. One ask: can we show last quarter's baseline on the metrics tab (simple table) so the executive slides don't need to dig for context?

Laura
Director, Product Operations
